offers_products.reason: Manufactures electric heat tracing cables, heaters, boilers, tubing bundles and power distribution panels.

offers_services.reason: Also provides engineering, installation, maintenance and project services for heat tracing systems, though products are larger.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells industrial heating systems to process industries, not to households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are industrial firms, EPC contractors, oil and gas, chemical and power companies, and data centers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue is mainly project-driven capital equipment orders, with some maintenance and replacement sales.

cyclical_demand.reason: Industrial and energy capital projects can be delayed or cut in downturns, though maintenance work is steadier.

big_ticket.reason: Engineered heat tracing systems and boilers are sold per project, large and infrequent for buyers.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay mainly for manufactured heating products and technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large oil and gas, chemical, power and infrastructure enterprises and big EPC contractors.

asset_heavy.reason: Manufacturing is moderate in scale; it grows without heavy plant, fleet or network investment.

notes: Asset intensity is a judgment call; services share is not stated on the site.
